# Hungama Digital Services

Hungama Digital Services is a Advertising Services company. Hungama Digital Services employs 8 people (-10.3% YoY, -3 people) and has an annual revenue of $11.3M, founded in 2011. Headquartered in Mumbai, India, with presence in United States. Its workforce is distributed across India and Hungary.

## About

Hungama Digital Services (HDS), one of India’s leading digital advertising and promotion marketing agencies. HDS was part of the digital services division of Hungama Digital Media Entertainment Pvt. Ltd. since 1999 till it became a part of the WPP worldwide group in 2011. 

A highly awarded digital and promotions marketing agency, we are a full service digital agency, with capabilities in digital ideation, production, and social media.

We offer our clients a gamut of digital solutions ranging from creative and promo marketing services, viral marketing campaigns, social media marketing and mobile marketing to applications, websites and video services.

Over the years, we have launched over thousands of mobile and digital campaigns for as many as more than hundred brands globally. Our clients straddle different verticals and industries and include Mahindra, Unilever, Microsoft, Intel, Tata Sky, Godrej and USL among others
